All 9 tests now pass (`node --test`), and I confirmed that myself. The delegate's own report said "2 tests" and cited evidence files that don't exist, so I didn't rely on it.

**Bugs fixed**
1. **`src/bill.js` (`splitBill`):** the leftover-cent check was `i <= leftover`, which gave one payer too many an extra cent. It is now `i < leftover`. This fixed "even split", "leftover cents go to the first payers" and "total is preserved".
2. **`src/duration.js` (`parseDuration`):** it only checked that at least one `<digits><h|m|s>` group existed, so input like `"10m and change"` was accepted and the junk silently ignored. It now throws `SyntaxError` unless the whole string is consecutive `<digits><unit>` groups. The old empty-match check became redundant, so I replaced it.

The tests are untouched, and `check_diff` found nothing suspicious. The edits were done by a Codex worker, and I checked the diff and test run myself.
